c74object.name: jam.jit.gl.ilda.sketch
c74object.digest: Render frames from an ILDA file to an Open GL context
c74object.description: Render frames from an ILDA file to an Open GL context.

method.name: exportpallet
method.digest: Export the custom color pallet as dictionary
method.description: Export the custom color pallet as dictionary

method.name: framecount
method.digest: Number of frames in the currently loaded ILDA file
method.description: Number of frames in the currently loaded ILDA file.

method.name: dictionary
method.digest: Use a dictionary to define the pattern of bangs produced
method.description: Use a dictionary to define the pattern of bangs produced.

method.name: ilda
method.digest: Reference to am ILDA file loaded by jam
method.description: Reference to am ILDA file loaded by jam.ilda.file

method.name: resetpallet
method.digest: Reset the custom color pallet to the ILDA default pallet colors
method.description: Reset the custom color pallet to the ILDA default pallet colors

attribute.name: anchor
attribute.digest: The anchor position in local space (default = 0
attribute.description: The anchor position in local space (default = 0. 0. 0.). Allows for offsetting the local 3D origin around which transforms are applied.

attribute.name: antialias
attribute.digest: Antialiasing flag (default = 0) On some hardware, the blend_enable attribute must also be enabled for antialiasing to work
attribute.description: Antialiasing flag (default = 0) On some hardware, the blend_enable attribute must also be enabled for antialiasing to work.

attribute.name: auto_material
attribute.digest: Automatic material attributes flag (default = 1) When the flag is set, and lighting is enabled for the object
attribute.description: Automatic material attributes flag (default = 1) When the flag is set, and lighting is enabled for the object.

attribute.name: automatic
attribute.digest: Automatic rendering flag (default = 1) When the flag is set, rendering occurs when the associated jit.gl.render object receives a bang message
attribute.description: Automatic rendering flag (default = 1) When the flag is set, rendering occurs when the associated jit.gl.render object receives a bang message.

attribute.name: blankingcolor
attribute.digest: If draw_blanking is enabled, the color blanked lines will be drawn
attribute.description: If draw_blanking is enabled, the color blanked lines will be drawn.

attribute.name: blend
attribute.description:
The named blending mode. The possible values are:
add = blend_mode 1 1
multiply = blend_mode 2 1
screen = blend_mode 4 1
exclusion = blend_mode 4 5
colorblend = blend_mode 3 4
alphablend = blend_mode 6 7
coloradd = blend_mode 3 1
alphaadd = blend_mode 6 1

attribute.name: blend_enable
attribute.digest: Blending flag (default = 0) When the flag is set, blending is enabled for all rendered objects
attribute.description: Blending flag (default = 0) When the flag is set, blending is enabled for all rendered objects.

attribute.name: blend_mode
attribute.digest: The source and destination planes associated with the blend mode (default = 6 7) Blend modes are specified in the form src_blend_mode dst_blend_mode
attribute.description:
The source and destination planes associated with the blend mode (default = 6 7) Blend modes are specified in the form src_blend_mode dst_blend_mode. The supported modes are:
0 = zero
1 = one
2 = destination color
3 = source color
4 = one minus destination color
5 = one minus source color
6 = source alpha
7 = one minus source alpha
8 = destination alpha
9 = one minus destination alpha
10 = source alpha saturate

attribute.name: cull_face
attribute.digest:
Face culling mode (default = 0 (no culling))
0 = no culling
1 = cull back face
2 = cull front faces
attribute.description:
Face culling mode (default = 0 (no culling))
0 = no culling
1 = cull back face
2 = cull front faces

attribute.name: custompallet
attribute.digest: Use custom color pallet for frames with indexed colors
attribute.description: Use custom color pallet for frames with indexed colors.

attribute.name: drawblanking
attribute.digest: Draw lines where the laser is blanked
attribute.description: Draw lines where the laser is blanked. (default=0)

attribute.name: drawto
attribute.digest: The named drawing context in which to draw (default = none) A named drawing context is a named instance of a jit.window, jit.pwindow, or jit.matrix object that has an instance of the jit.gl.render object associated with it
attribute.description: The named drawing context in which to draw (default = none) A named drawing context is a named instance of a jit.window, jit.pwindow, or jit.matrix object that has an instance of the jit.gl.render object associated with it.

attribute.name: force_2d
attribute.digest: Set to 1 the z-axis position is ignored, regardles of the specified format in a frame
attribute.description: Set to 1 the z-axis position is ignored, regardles of the specified format in a frame. This can help to remove distortions in some cases, when the file is not properly generated.

attribute.name: lighting_enable
attribute.digest: Lighting enabled flag (default = 0) When the flag is set, lighting is calculated
attribute.description: Lighting enabled flag (default = 0) When the flag is set, lighting is calculated.

attribute.name: linewidth
attribute.digest: Line width for drawing regular segments
attribute.description: Line width for drawing regular segments.

attribute.name: linewidth_blanking
attribute.digest: Line width for drawing blanking segments
attribute.description: Line width for drawing blanking segments.

attribute.name: monochrome
attribute.digest: Igore color information and draw everything in 'monochromecolor'
attribute.description: Igore color information and draw everything in 'monochromecolor'.

attribute.name: monochromecolor
attribute.digest: If 'monochrome' is enabled, the color everything will be drawn
attribute.description: If 'monochrome' is enabled, the color everything will be drawn.

attribute.name: opacity
attribute.digest: Opacity value applied when 'overrideopacity' is set to 1
attribute.description: Opacity value applied when 'overrideopacity' is set to 1.

attribute.name: overrideopacity
attribute.digest:
Override color opacity values when rendering a frame and use the value from the 'opacity' attribute instead.
Note: 'blend_enable' must be set to 1 for this to take effect
attribute.description:
Override color opacity values when rendering a frame and use the value from the 'opacity' attribute instead.
Note: 'blend_enable' must be set to 1 for this to take effect.

attribute.name: position
attribute.digest: The 3D origin in the form x y z (default = 0
attribute.description: The 3D origin in the form x y z (default = 0. 0. 0.)

attribute.name: rotate
attribute.digest: The angle of rotation and the xyz vector about which the rotation is performed in the form rotation-angle x y z (default = 0
attribute.description: The angle of rotation and the xyz vector about which the rotation is performed in the form rotation-angle x y z (default = 0. 0. 0. 1.)

attribute.name: scale
attribute.digest: The 3D scaling factor in the form x y z (default = 1
attribute.description: The 3D scaling factor in the form x y z (default = 1. 1. 1.)
